description: This file contains functions for converting between Anthropic message formats and VS Code language model chat messages, including safe object conversion, role mapping, and text extraction.

methods.name: asObjectSafe
methods.description: Safely converts a value into a plain object, handling null, JSON strings, and objects.

methods.name: convertToVsCodeLmMessages
methods.description: Converts Anthropic message parameters into VS Code language model chat messages.

methods.name: convertToAnthropicRole
methods.description: Maps VS Code chat message roles to Anthropic role strings.

methods.name: extractTextCountFromMessage
methods.description: Extracts concatenated text content from a VS Code language model chat message.
